run_generators_cli: run the generators CLI to produce surface form and logical form pairs from a templates JSON file
generate_template_surface_logical_pairs: generate surface form and logical form pairs from template information using the generate_template function
extract_all_templates: extract all templates from template data JSON using the getAllTemplates function
generate_random_template_pairs: generate a specified number of random template pairs using the generatePairs function
review_generator_class: review the Generator class that produces surface form and logical form pairs from template information
